description: Yahoo DSP Dot image pixels on sp.analytics.yahoo.com/spp.pl, as generated in the pixel instrumentation code.

params.name: a
params.description: It is the project ID. Every official image pixel Yahoo returns includes `a`, and the JavaScript twin sends it as `projectId`.
params.fix_hint: Copy the image pixel from Yahoo DSP so `a` carries the project ID.

params.name: .yp
params.description: It is the Yahoo Dot pixel ID. Every official image pixel includes `.yp`, and the Conversions API docs identify Dot firings by that parameter.
params.fix_hint: Copy the image pixel from Yahoo DSP so `.yp` carries the pixel ID.

params.name: he
params.description: Enhanced matching sends the email as a SHA-256 hex digest.
params.fix_hint: Hash the email with SHA-256 and send the hex digest as `he`.

params.name: hph
params.description: Enhanced matching sends the phone number hashed.
params.fix_hint: Hash the phone number and send the digest as `hph`.

rules.message: A parameter carries what looks like a raw email address. Yahoo documents enhanced matching as `he`, a SHA-256 digest.
rules.fix_hint: Hash the email with SHA-256 and send it as `he`.
